declaredOptions.label: RTP folders
declaredOptions.description: Folders searched for RTP assets the game does not ship. Joined into one --rtp-path value, which EasyRPG splits again on a colon (src/filefinder_rtp.cpp:129-150).

declaredOptions.label: Save folder
declaredOptions.description: Where save files are written; defaults to the game folder (--save-path, src/player.cpp:573).

declaredOptions.label: Font folder
declaredOptions.description: Folder searched for fonts (--font-path, src/game_config.cpp:566). EasyRPG accepts one folder here, not a list.

declaredOptions.label: Text encoding
declaredOptions.description: Encoding of the game text, for games whose language does not match the device, for example 932 for Japanese (--encoding, src/player.cpp:642).

declaredOptions.label: Language
declaredOptions.description: Name of a translation folder shipped with the game; default uses the original text (--language, src/player.cpp:666).

declaredOptions.label: Force engine version
declaredOptions.description: Overrides the RPG Maker version EasyRPG detects (--engine, src/game_config_game.cpp:73, accepted values at :39-58).

declaredOptions.label: MIDI SoundFont file
declaredOptions.description: SoundFont file used for the game MIDI music. A file path (--soundfont, src/game_config.cpp:530).

declaredOptions.label: Music volume
declaredOptions.description: Background music volume, 0 to 100 (--music-volume, src/game_config.cpp:518).

declaredOptions.label: Sound effect volume
declaredOptions.description: Sound effect volume, 0 to 100 (--sound-volume, src/game_config.cpp:524).

declaredOptions.label: Scaling method
declaredOptions.description: How the game picture is scaled to the screen (--scaling, src/game_config.cpp:492, values at src/game_config.h:127).

declaredOptions.label: Game resolution
declaredOptions.description: Widescreen and ultrawide are experimental and can glitch (--game-resolution, src/game_config.cpp:498, values at src/game_config.h:134).

declaredOptions.label: Fullscreen
declaredOptions.description: Starts fullscreen rather than in a window (--fullscreen / --window, src/game_config.cpp:474-481).

declaredOptions.label: Vertical sync
declaredOptions.description: Synchronises presentation with the display refresh (--vsync / --no-vsync, src/game_config.cpp:440).

declaredOptions.label: Frame rate cap
declaredOptions.description: Frames per second limit; 60 is the rate the games expect and 0 removes the limit (--fps-limit, src/game_config.cpp:444).

declaredOptions.label: Font 1 file
declaredOptions.description: Font file used where the game asks for its first font. A file path (--font1, src/game_config.cpp:536).

declaredOptions.label: Font 1 size
declaredOptions.description: Point size for font 1 (--font1-size, src/game_config.cpp:542).

declaredOptions.label: Font 2 file
declaredOptions.description: Font file used where the game asks for its second font. A file path (--font2, src/game_config.cpp:548).

declaredOptions.label: Font 2 size
declaredOptions.description: Point size for font 2 (--font2-size, src/game_config.cpp:554).

declaredOptions.label: Test play mode
declaredOptions.description: Runs the game as the editor test play, enabling debug features (--test-play, src/player.cpp:509).

declaredOptions.label: Skip the title screen graphic
declaredOptions.description: Hides the title background (--hide-title, src/player.cpp:514).

declaredOptions.label: Disable all compatibility patches
declaredOptions.description: Runs the game exactly as the original engine would, with every patch below turned off and locked (--no-patch, src/game_config_game.cpp:90).

declaredOptions.label: DynRPG patch
declaredOptions.description: For RPG Maker 2003 games built against DynRPG (src/game_config_game.cpp:111).

declaredOptions.label: Maniac Patch
declaredOptions.description: For games built against the Maniac Patch, which many later Japanese releases require (src/game_config_game.cpp:116).

declaredOptions.label: EasyRPG extensions
declaredOptions.description: Enables the engine own extensions to the RPG Maker command set (src/game_config_game.cpp:106).

declaredOptions.label: This-event support in common events
declaredOptions.description: Lets common events refer to the calling event, as the community patch does (src/game_config_game.cpp:126).

declaredOptions.label: Picture limit removed
declaredOptions.description: Lifts the engine cap on simultaneous pictures (src/game_config_game.cpp:131).

declaredOptions.label: Ineluki Key Patch
declaredOptions.description: For games using the Ineluki key input patch (src/game_config_game.cpp:136).

declaredOptions.label: RPG Maker 2003 commands in 2000 games
declaredOptions.description: Allows 2003 event commands inside an RPG Maker 2000 game (src/game_config_game.cpp:141).

declaredOptions.label: Anti-lag switch number
declaredOptions.description: Number of the switch that suppresses event page refreshes; 0 turns the patch off (src/game_config_game.cpp:146).

declaredOptions.label: Direct menu variable number
declaredOptions.description: Number of the variable that opens a menu scene directly; 0 turns the patch off (src/game_config_game.cpp:158).
